secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key for server-side admin access. Find in Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API.

secrets.name: ALPACA_LIVE_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Alpaca live account API key ID for market data and live trading. Find in Alpaca dashboard → API Keys (Live account).

secrets.name: ALPACA_LIVE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Alpaca live account API secret key. Find in Alpaca dashboard → API Keys (Live account).

secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Cookie encryption secret for the passcode gate (≥32 characters). Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48. Required only if SITE_PASSWORD is set.

secrets.name: SITE_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Passcode required to open the app. If unset, the app is open to anyone. Set in Vercel environment variables.

secrets.name: MARKET_DATA_API_KEY
secrets.description: Polygon.io API key for whole-market daily bars. Only needed if app_settings.provider is 'polygon'. If absent, falls back to Alpaca's free IEX feed.

secrets.name: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.description: VAPID public key for web push notifications. Generate with: bun run vapid. Optional — push notifications are skipped if not set.

secrets.name: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: VAPID private key for web push notifications. Generate with: bun run vapid. Optional.
